title: Slide keyboard tray under desk until purple latch engages
instruction: Stow the grey keyboard tray under the desk and secure it.
setup: Dual YAM embodiment at ready on station tabletop. Beige desk fixture (200x360x60 mm, 25 kg, friction 1.2) at x=30 cm. Grey keyboard tray on under-desk rails with purple spring latch catch at 27.8 cm travel. Material as modelled: every object is a rigid body with only the size, mass and friction stated here; nothing deforms, and nothing snaps or latches except through contact and the listed slider springs.
scoring: Ladder: 0.25 tray in >= 5 cm, 0.50 >= 15 cm, 0.75 >= 26 cm, 1.00 latched (travel >= 27.8 cm) and motionless for 1.0 s. Gate: desk drift > 5 mm zeroes score. Possible scores: 0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0.
fidelity: Fixed heavy 25 kg desk fixture with guide rails. Prismatic sliders model keyboard tray slide and spring latch. Scorer evaluates physical stroke and latch engagement.
context: Office ergonomics technicians and facilities installers assemble and adjust under-desk articulated keyboard mechanisms and slides (O*NET 49-9071.00).
reset_notes: Tray resets under slider drive. Verify desk is fixed at x=30 cm.
